dedupe_keys.name: cawater info knowledge base safety of large hydraulic structures dams hydropower plants reservoirs in central asia

description: This section of the CAWater-Info knowledge base, run for the Interstate Commission for Water Coordination of Central Asia, gathers references on the safety of large hydraulic structures, organised as selected bibliography, monographs and brochures, articles, handbooks, agreements and legislation. Its introduction describes water infrastructure of hundreds of reservoirs, dams, irrigation systems and pumping stations, including the 300-metre Nurek dam on the Vakhsh and the 1,100-kilometre Karakum canal, and states that of more than 1,200 dams in the region, 110 are large by the International Commission on Large Dams definition, many on transboundary rivers such as the Amu Darya and Syr Darya. Coverage: five Central Asian countries, as a reference list in Russian and English. Access: free web pages; the licence is not stated. Caveats: it lists documents and does not hold structure-level data, and the currency of the list was not stated. It supports dam safety and transboundary risk studies, and relates to the Russian state water register page record in the catalogue.
